verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product catalog API, so querying order status after purchase is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no order-status or shipment-tracking endpoint. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: price-tracking webhooks follow product price changes, not orders, and affiliate sale recording and attribution say nothing about an agent querying the status of an order it placed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
